title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
kidExplanation: Numbered beads in a bag. Ignore the bag order. What is the longest run of neighbors like 3–4–5–6?
plainProblem: Return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. Aim for O(n).

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: Sort, then scan streaks. O(n log n).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: Put numbers in a hash set. A streak should start only when num-1 is missing.

thinkingSteps.title: Better idea
thinkingSteps.body: For each start, walk num+1, num+2… while present, tracking the best length.

thinkingSteps.title: Why O(n)
thinkingSteps.body: Each number is visited a constant number of times across all walks.

pattern.name: Hash set / hash map for seen items
pattern.whenToSpot: You need fast lookups of values you already saw.

complexity.timeReason: Set builds in O(n); consecutive walks amortize to O(n).
complexity.spaceReason: The hash set stores unique numbers.

edgeCases: Duplicates and boundary values from the constraints.
